apis.name: OpenCorporates
apis.why_notable: World's largest open database of companies and corporate ownership; widely used for KYC, research, and graph-style entity linkage.

apis.name: Companies House
apis.why_notable: Official UK company registry REST API; free self-serve access to filings, officers, and PSCs used heavily in data pipelines.

apis.name: Data.gov.uk
apis.why_notable: UK central open-data catalog (CKAN) for discovering and programmatically accessing government datasets.

apis.name: GDELT Project
apis.why_notable: Near-real-time global news event, theme, and location graph used for conflict, media, and analytics research.

apis.name: NewsAPI
apis.why_notable: Simple HTTP news search/headlines API aggregating thousands of sources; common entry point for media analytics apps.

apis.name: MediaStack
apis.why_notable: Real-time and historical news data API with multi-language coverage for analytics and monitoring products.

apis.name: Guardian Open Platform
apis.why_notable: Full-text searchable Guardian content API; long-running free developer tier for journalism and NLP datasets.

apis.name: NYT Article Search
apis.why_notable: New York Times article search with metadata and facets; staple corpus for research and content analytics.
